name: 表示件数と文字検索と書き出しを備える結果操作
prompt: Create a clean compact Japanese Lighthouse results-control component on pure white. Primary corrected original toolbar controls exact states/glyphs; native mock secondary Japanese copy/layout. Top label exact '表示する内訳' Meiryo Regular14/24 dark. Below one wide compact controls row: LEFT white thin-neutral-outline dropdown exact '上位1件（既定）' Regular14/24 with small open down-V at right, preserving original Top1Default state. Immediately outside dropdown restore small thin circled-lowercase-i utility. MIDDLE white neutral-outline search field with original small outline circle/down-right-handle magnifier at left, native gray placeholder '結果を検索' Regular14/24. Flexible space. RIGHT white neutral-outline export button with ORIGINAL box-and-rightward-arrow export glyph (open-right square box, horizontal shaft exits right with arrowhead pointing RIGHT; never down-arrow download or document), exact 'CSVを書き出す' Regular14/24. Immediately outside after export restore SECOND small circled lowercase i. Both info icons are present in original but mock omits them. Keep source modest4px corner radii and thin borders, no shadows/filled primary. Utility glyphs slate#526173 at quiet source scale, HEIGHT about0.9times Japanese character height, never enlarged conventional icons. Text dark#1D1D1D/meta#6E6E6E, zero tracking, all Regular, no Bold. Component may be desktop-wide so all restored controls and labels fit without crowding; retain native top-label-then-row hierarchy. No green needed: neutral result utilities. No data table/chart, phone chrome, extra heading, default changes, extra buttons, fields or selected count edits. All content complete. Static raster candidate only, no actual row-limit/search/export functionality.
reviewNotes: Correct Top1Default Japanese qualifier, two infoi, search input, CSVformat and box-right-arrow export anatomy restored. Search/info/export glyphs slightly oversized and export/dropdown glyphs black rather than coherent slate. Target utility scale/color only, preserve all copy/state/borders.
